body.name: Canonical embedded switching certificate \(E_{\mathbf B}\)
body.construction: Let \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\) be an ordinary identifying collection.  Acquire one full SELECT--RAND--READ protocol \(S_B\) for each distinct \(B\), together with all labels in \(\Lambda_{\mathbf B}\) and every canonical labelled single-district source factor of the laws \(P_b(V\setminus B)\).  Run complete unconditional \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) on this finite source collection.  For every branch \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\in\Omega\), choose the lexicographically first successful protocol--slice--source triple and canonical concrete restriction transcript, and make that branch the unique owner of the corresponding switching record, merging records that have the same triple.  Add one empty-ownership paid-protocol marker for any acquired \(S_B\) not used by a nonempty record, merge equal records, and sort lexicographically.  The resulting branch-indexed switching certificate is \(E_{\mathbf B}\).
